ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray surface area to low-intensity black/dark-gray patterned markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of dark circular rings (rosettes) across both lobes. A large, contiguous low-intensity dark patch is visible on the inner-left quadrant. High-intensity white/cream clusters are localized at the distal fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitudes (3-12 pixels) forming a jagged boundary along the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a predominantly concave curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme density of localized, dark circular ring structures (rosettes) of varying diameters (5-15 pixels) across the entire visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (encrusting organisms) localized primarily on the distal tips and trailing edges of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'leopard-style' pigmentation pattern consisting of hundreds of overlapping circular scars and dark rings.
